title: Construction Coordinator
description:
Construction Coordinator (Telecom/Data Center)
Bowling Green, OH (Onsite)
Long-term contract

Summary:
The Construction Coordinator supports the successful execution of client delivery projects by coordinating daily project activities, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring seamless alignment across teams. This role applies standard PMO methodologies to help deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget. The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive communicator who thrives on supporting technical teams, interfacing with trade crews, and improving overall project performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Daily Field Coordination & Execution
  • Task Assignment: Assess daily deliverables and assign field tasks to technicians on-site.
  • Progress Tracking: Maintain real-time visibility into crew productivity, updates, and task tracking using Fieldwire construction management software.
  • Material Logistics: Assist with ordering, gathering, and managing field supplies, materials, and rental equipment.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Attend active site meetings and partner closely with Field Technicians, Quality Control/QA inspectors, Project Managers, and General Contractors.
  • Union Environment Coordination: Facilitate daily operations and collaboration when working alongside Union crews.

Project Administration & Documentation
  • PMO Standards: Apply established PMO processes, compliance rules, and methodologies consistently across all assigned projects.
  • Document Control: Create, update, and maintain meticulous project documentation, tracking schedules, timelines, requirements gathering, and change-control data.
  • Communication Hub: Serve as a primary point of contact between stakeholders, external vendors, and internal teams. Prepare agendas, PowerPoint presentations, and reports.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze incoming project data—including resource utilization, schedules, and delivery performance metrics—to build recurring and ad hoc reports for operations leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated construction coordination or project assistance experience, specifically within the telecom services / low-voltage industry.
  • Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of telecom infrastructure projects, terminology, and workflows, including inside plant (ISP) new builds, structured cabling (CAT 6/Fiber), cable patching, trunking, and rack-and-stack architectures.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).
  • Software Proficiency:
    • Required: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel) and MS Teams.
  • Soft Skills: High adaptability with transitioning priorities, an excellent "can-do" collaborative attitude, and superb written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Construction Systems: Hands-on working knowledge of Fieldwire (strongly desired).
  • Labor Environment: Demonstrated experience working comfortably alongside Union crews and labor structures.
  • Advanced Tools: Familiarity with PowerPoint, Visio, SharePoint, MS Project, PPM tools, ERP platforms, ServiceNow, or Salesforce.com.
  • Specialized Builds: Past exposure to data center construction environments or large-scale network infrastructure retrofits.

title: Assembler
description:
• We are seeking a highly experienced Solder Assembler to join our precision electronics manufacturing team.
  • The successful candidate will be an expert in both surface‐mount technology (SMT) and through‐hole soldering, with a proven track record of removing, repairing, and replacing a wide variety of components—including bottom‐terminated parts such as QFNs, BGAs, and LGAs.
  • The role requires hands‐on use of advanced rework equipment and the ability to verify workmanship using X‐ray inspection techniques.
  • Perform high‐mix, low‐volume assembly of SMT and through‐hole components on complex printed circuit boards (PCBs).
  • Execute removal, replacement, and repair of bottom‐terminated components (QFNs, BGAs, LGAs) using hot‐air pencils, hot plates, and other rework tools.
  • Conduct precise reflow, pre‐heat, and cooling cycles to meet component‐specific thermal profiles.
  • Operate and maintain X‐ray inspection equipment to evaluate solder joints on hidden pads and verify rework quality.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, work orders, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to ensure correct component placement and orientation.
  • Perform in‐process quality checks (visual, AOI, X‐ray) and document results per quality system requirements.
  • Troubleshoot solder‐related defects (e.g., tombstoning, voids, solder bridges) and implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain ESD‐controlled environments; follow all safety and compliance procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous‐improvement initiatives, suggesting tooling upgrades or process optimizations.
  • Operator must be willing to work under a microscope for long periods of time while inspecting and working on PWBs

title: Oracle EBS Financials Developer
description:
Oracle E-Business Suite Financials Developer
Richmond, VA (Hybrid, Onsite 2–3 days per week)

SUMMARY
The Oracle E-Business Suite Financials Developer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of Oracle EBS Financial modules and related business processes. This position works closely with functional analysts, business users, and database administrators to enhance and maintain enterprise financial systems that support critical accounting and operational functions. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled Oracle developer with deep expertise in Financials (AP, AR, GL, PO, Inventory) and various interfaces, who can translate business requirements into efficient, scalable technical solutions within the EBS framework.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Development & Optimization: Analyze, design, develop, optimize, and maintain customizations, extensions, and integrations for Oracle E-Business Suite Financial modules (primarily R12).
  • Module Support: Support and enhance core Financial modules, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), Purchasing (PO), and Inventory (INV), alongside custom-built processes within the Oracle application.
  • Technical Implementation: Develop and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, triggers, functions, and reports using Oracle development tools (TOAD, Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, BI Publisher).
  • System Integration: Support data migration and interface development activities, including API calls, Web Services, and flat-file integrations.
  • System Maintenance: Coordinate regular system updates with the Database Administrator and implement enhancements to meet operational requirements.
  • Troubleshooting: Debug and resolve complex application issues, performance bottlenecks, and data discrepancies.
  • Collaboration & Requirements Gathering: Work with business and functional teams to gather requirements, document technical solutions, and implement new functionality.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure adherence to secure coding practices, change management standards, and IT governance policies.
  • Documentation & Delivery: Provide clear documentation on all system and process enhancements, source-to-target mappings, and operational guides. Participate in project planning, peer reviews, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Education: BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • EBS Experience: 7+ years of hands-on technical development experience with Oracle E-Business Suite R12 Financials.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in PL/SQL, SQL, Oracle Forms/Reports, and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Domain Knowledge: Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Financial business processes (AP, AR, GL, PO, INV).
  • System Integration: Proven experience leading technical workloads for large-scale system integration projects, interface designs, and data migrations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with financial business partners and across cross-functional technical teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Advanced EBS Tools: Hands-on experience with EBS APIs, OA Framework, and Web ADI is highly desirable.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or hybrid EBS-to-Cloud environments.
  • Development Tools: Experience with Oracle Application Express (APEX) and Oracle Workflow.
  • Methodologies: Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and familiarity with modern DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Jira, etc.).
  • Industry Context: Prior understanding of public sector financial systems or large-scale enterprise financial operations.
  • Certifications: Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent technical certifications.

title: Sys Integratn/Test Eng
description:
Job Details or Description:-
  • Plans, implements, tests, documents, and maintains solutions for the integration and testing of in-house developed and COTS/GOTS components, elements, subsystems and/or systems.
  • Synthesizes customer contractual needs and requirements into system test solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule and cost constraints.
  • Establishes functional and technical specifications and standards, solves hardware/software interface problems, defines input/output parameters, and ensures integration of the entire system or subsystem.
  • Reviews, evaluates and derives requirements for testability, develops and directs preparation and execution of comprehensive test plans, procedures and schedules for complete systems and/or subsystems.
  • Coordinates subsystem and/or system testing activities with programs and other organizations.
  • Performs analysis of test results and prepares comprehensive subsystem and/or system level evaluation reports which verify and validate system performance.
  • Writes discrepancy reports and performs integration regression testing to verify/validate incorporated fixes to software, components, subsystems and systems.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE or SKILLS:-
  • 4 - 6 Years experience with Software Development (C, C++, LabView preferred)
  • 4 - 6 Years experience with Production
  • 6 + Years experience of Test Equipment Design
  • 6 + Years experience of Electronic Testing
  • 6 + Years experience of Mechanical Testing


DESIRED SKILLS/NICE TO HAVE:-
  • LabView/LabWindows CVI, NI experience in both development and maintenance capacities on complex systems.
  • Proficient SW skills in C, C++, coupled with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) HW integration expertise (switches, VXI/PXI chassis, EO testing, automation).
  • Automated Test equipment development/maintenance experience in a high-volume production environment.
  • The source program is an Electro-Optic sensor solution for military platforms.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Administrative Assistant to support the Controller Vice President & the Controller leadership team. As the Administrative Assistant, you will:
- Provide general correspondence, schedule meetings, make travel arrangements and complete expense reports, answer stakeholder inquiries, help manage the business rhythm and perform other duties, as assigned.
- Proactively manage executive calendars, collaborating with other admins and prioritizing & managing scheduling conflicts.
- Anticipate needs and troubleshoot and manage complex travel itineraries.
- Perform complex and diversified administrative functions that require independent decision making and problem solving with minimal direction.
- Manage conference rooms as needed (including reservations, Video Teleconferencing (VTC), Teams and other IT as necessary).
- Order and maintain office supply Inventory, organize shipments, mail, etc in support of the VP and team.
- Determine priorities of non-routine situations and will participate and lead miscellaneous projects or initiatives as needed, including providing support to the department staff.
- May occasionally need to provide assistance outside normal office hours to address an unexpected business issue.

Basic Qualifications :
-Minimum 5 years of progressive administrative support experience including supporting senior leadership / executives
- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite – Outlook including calendar management, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams
- Experience with arranging travel and completing expense reports.
- Knowledge of standard office equipment and technology for both operation and basic trouble shooting (i.e phone, iPhone, computer, laptop)

Desired skills :
-Experience with RMS or Lockheed Martin
-Ability to work with minimal direction & company/team first attitude at all times.
- Excellent interpersonal skills/ability to interact with all levels of management, peers, government, and other industry personnel in a proficient, courteous, discrete and professional manner
- Well organized and detail-oriented with flexibility and ability to effectively balance the handling of multiple assignments and tasks in a dynamic and fast-moving team environment
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information and act in a professional manner
- Willingness to assume increasing levels of responsibilities and have a strong desire for professional continued self-improvement, a professional demeanor and well-spoken
- Ability to anticipate requirements of business leaders

WHO YOU ARE
If you have exceptional administrative skills with extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office and computer technology along with strong interpersonal and organizational skills, we want to meet you. We're looking for a team player who is proactive and detail oriented. Able to handle sensitive information discretely as well as maintain composure in a fast-paced environment. A self-starter with strong initiative, proven ability to multi-task and drive closure in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities and short/firm deadlines that align to company deliverables.
